_comment: NPC dialogue for merchant_bram (Phase E §3 barks; quest lines land with Act 1).

1.speaker: Merchant Bram
1.text: Bram buys bone by the handful and sells it by the finger. He needs a consignment before the caravan leaves.

2.speaker: Merchant Bram
2.text: Gather 5 Bone Fragment. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Merchant Bram
1.text: Bram has a standing order with the tanners and no patience for suppliers who stop supplying.

2.speaker: Merchant Bram
2.text: Slay 10 Slime Grunt. Come back to me when it is done.

1.speaker: Merchant Bram
1.text: Bram has already decided you are buying something.

3.speaker: Merchant Bram
3.text: Caravans, mostly. The ones that arrive. The ones that do not arrive still cost me, which is a tax I did not vote for.

4.speaker: Merchant Bram
4.text: Whoever pays first. You are not offended by that. You would do the same, and you would sleep fine.

2.speaker: Merchant Bram
2.text: Go on. I have the time, which is the only thing anyone in this valley still has in quantity.

choices.text: Where do you get your stock?

barks.text: Potion's brewed for people who come back. Buy two.
Gold's gold, friend. I don't ask where it's been.
Ash in the water supply this week. Don't ask what it does to the ale.
